$schema: pages.context — captured 2026-05-13 from the xmc:fullscreen extension point. Returns an error envelope because `pages.context` is ONLY valid inside Page Builder context-panel / custom-field extension points. The Marketplace SDK exposes this query universally, but Cloud Portal only resolves it for Page Builder surfaces. The error itself is the documented expected response from non-Page-Builder surfaces.

$capture.operator_note: Not available in full page of course

pages_context_availability.decision: PRD-000 is xmc:fullscreen only and therefore NEVER consumes `pages.context`. The PaywallGate component MUST NOT call this query. PRD-002+ Dashboard Widget tile is also non-Page-Builder.
pages_context_availability.rationale: Documented error shape captured here as proof — `pages.context` returns an `EXECUTION_ERROR` (not just null) from non-Page-Builder surfaces. Adopters who fork the blueprint into a Page Builder Context Panel app would call it; the blueprint itself doesn't.
